requirements.rule: Art. 29: the APE paid by the Cassa Edile.
requirements.remediation: Model the APE as a Cassa Edile payment.

requirements.rule: The engine computes the rate of the separate taxation of arrears from PriorYearTaxFacts.net_income_biennio (art. 21 cc. 1, 3 TUIR) and reduces the tax by ArrearsEvent.unused_deductions, the deductions of artt. 12 and 13 cc. 1-2 the worker did not use in the years the arrears refer to (art. 21 c. 4). An arrears event that does not state them, among which the una tantum the engine pays itself, is taxed without the reduction, so the tax may be overstated.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.variable_pay.arrears.handlers._handle_arrears; art. 21 TUIR (Normattiva, text in force from 31-12-2024 to 31-12-2026, page sha256 9638f2c5aec6e3615193a672b6d07c3cd31083640b1c890b73022aa9951745f1)
requirements.remediation: State ArrearsEvent.unused_deductions from the worker's declaration of the deductions used each year; for the una tantum, carry it into the events the engine generates.

requirements.rule: CAPISQUADRA (classification, p. 103; Art. 24 point 4): the 10% maggiorazione of the operaio put in charge of at least five operai is the allowance CAPOSQUADRA (role 'caposquadra'), in the base of the riposi annui and Cassa Edile percentages. Not modelled: provincial EET/ITS and piecework minimum in the percentage base; assignment duration is supplied by the role input.
requirements.remediation: Supply provincial and piecework components of the percentage base and assignment duration.

requirements.rule: CASSA EDILE CONTRIBUTION: the contribution to the Cassa Edile, set by the provincial agreements and shared by employer and worker (5,47% on the hourly elements in the Agrigento table of the Ministry of Labour of May 2025), is not modelled; only the 18.5% accrual for ferie and gratifica is. The worker's share lowers the net pay.
requirements.remediation: Pass the provincial Cassa Edile contribution as a bilateral fund event, or model the provincial rates.

requirements.rule: Art. 29 L. 341/1995: the riduzione contributiva edile on the employer INPS contributions of full-time operai.
requirements.remediation: Model the riduzione contributiva edile of the year.

requirements.rule: A first- or third-level apprentice (D.Lgs. 81/2015 artt. 43 and 45) is paid by the CCNL dual_apprenticeship tracks, but the INPS contributions and the other rates of the run are those of the professionalising apprentice: the contribution regime of these apprentices is not sourced. On a final-settlement run that pays both its month and the ratei, Apprentice.hours splits both by one set of hours.
requirements.remediation: Source the INPS contribution regime of first- and third-level apprentices and apply it; give a final-settlement run separate hours for its month and its ratei.

requirements.rule: SICKNESS (Art. 26): direct employer integration uses hourly minimum and ex contingenza (plus territorial allowance where available), excluding EDR, times one sixth of contracted weekly hours on six days a week excluding holidays. Waiting days 1-3 are unpaid for episodes of at most six days, paid at 0.5495 above six and 1.0495 above twelve; INPS-covered days 4-20 use 0.3795 and days 21-180 use 0.1565; non-INPS-covered days 181-365 use 0.5495. Not modelled: the 4.95% annual-rest payment for waiting days of episodes up to six days and on the injury day (60% on injury days 1-3); Cassa Edile sickness and injury accruals (18.5% gross, 14.2% net for sickness waiting days and from day 4; 7.4% and 5.7% on injury days 4-90; 4.6% and 3.6% from day 91) and the no-direct-pay exception of Allegato D point 4. Provincial territorial pay and actual site hours are not bundled, so only known components enter the base. Sick hours do not deduct from hourly worked pay.
requirements.remediation: Model the short-episode annual-rest payment and Cassa Edile accruals on sickness and injury, including site-hour and no-direct-pay rules.

requirements.rule: Verbale of 3 March 2022, Allegato 5: the una tantum premio di ingresso of EUR 100 to operai under 29.
requirements.remediation: Model the premio di ingresso with the age of the worker.

requirements.rule: Art. 20-21: the indennità for lavori speciali disagiati, alta montagna and cantiere ferroviario.

Art. 17 point 3: eight hours of pay, with 4.95% and 18.5% on the holiday treatment, are included when the caller supplies paid_holiday_days; horizontal part time scales the hours by agreed weekly hours. An unknown count raises a missing-fact issue; zero confirms none. Not modelled: 9.6 hours for discontinuous workers, the separate 4 November treatment and holiday placement in vertical or mixed part-time schedules. The caller must resolve local patron saint dates, employment eligibility and any suspension; no automatic holiday calendar is applied.
requirements.remediation: Resolve eligible holiday dates, discontinuous work and vertical or mixed schedules; supply the eligible count after checking employment and suspension conditions. Model the distinct 4 November treatment.

requirements.rule: A parental leave by the hour takes half the average daily hours a day and counts two such days as one day of leave, the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter D.Lgs. 151/2001 (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.2); a collective agreement, also of the company, that sets other hours to a day of leave or other rules of cumulation prevails, and the bundle holds none.
requirements.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: The days of parental leave beyond the indemnified months (three of each parent and three of the couple, nine of a sole parent) are paid nothing: art. 34 c. 3 D.Lgs. 151/2001 pays them 30% when the parent's income is below 2.5 times the trattamento minimo di pensione, an income test and a yearly amount the engine does not model.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.parental.rules.allocate; D.Lgs. 151/2001 art. 34 (Normattiva, text in force on 2026-10-30, page sha256 aaf521a98f84e5d33cad1deee74452d789e5c58ec3d1ede4567453d7b7bd3967)
requirements.remediation: Source the yearly trattamento minimo and the income the test reads, take the income as a fact of the leave and pay the further days at 30% when the condition holds, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: PART-TIME SUPPLEMENTARY HOURS: Art. 78 pays horizontal part-time operai 20% on the direct hourly remuneration up to 40 weekly hours. OT_SUPPLEMENTARE applies only to operai; the engine does not apply its incidence to deferred pay, TFR or Cassa Edile accruals. For impiegati Art. 78 also sets 20%, but on different Art. 44 elements, all-inclusive and without TFR incidence; that base is not derived here. The 10% for flexible clauses is separate and not modelled.
requirements.remediation: Model the operai incidence on deferred pay, TFR and Cassa Edile accruals, and the distinct impiegati hourly base before resolving this note.

requirements.rule: Two garnishments of the same kind, or two salary assignments, share the measure of their kind (a fifth, or the tenth or seventh of the agente della riscossione) in the order of notification: art. 545 c. 4 c.p.c. sets 'un quinto per i tributi ... ed in eguale misura per ogni altro credito' and art. 5 DPR 180/1950 a cessione 'fino al quinto', but no text read says how two orders of the same kind split the measure, so the later order may be under- or overstated.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.personal_withholding.services.same_kind_paths; art. 545 c.p.c. (Normattiva, page sha256 1fa0acce41c8fa68d80eba137bd4fcbe903016fa97ac4df183cc0ce55897ce66); art. 5 DPR 180/1950 (Normattiva, page sha256 461c2014ffdc7d93ddc0761877b9cd4b4964c256165ef252412a3c38a78a4919)
requirements.remediation: Source how the employer splits the measure between two orders of the same kind (art. 499 c.p.c. on the intervention of creditors, case law of the Cassazione) and apply it, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: Art. 46: the EVR set by the provincial agreements.
requirements.remediation: Add the provincial EVR as an input.

requirements.rule: Mensa, trasporto and trasferta, set by the provincial agreements (verbale 2025).
requirements.remediation: Add the provincial mensa, trasporto and trasferta as inputs.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid none, its treatment not being sourced.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.

requirements.rule: INDENNITÀ TERRITORIALE DI SETTORE: set by the provincial agreements (Art. 12) and owed to every operaio, also in the base of the 4.95% and 18.5% and in the TFR base of Art. 33. Not modelled: the net pay and the employer cost are short of it.
requirements.remediation: Model the indennità territoriale di settore with a fact naming the province, then remove this note.

requirements.rule: The una tantum of a renewal is paid from the CCNL data with readings no text read settles in full: a month of service in the covered period counts with the days of the una tantum (15 when the text is silent), over the months of the period; the absences of a month do not reduce it, though a text may pay the months 'di effettiva prestazione'; a part time is paid in proportion to its hours; a run without the employment period is paid none; the share of the covered months of earlier years is taxed apart as arrears.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.una_tantum.rules.una_tantum_events; CCNL agenti immobiliari FIAIP 19 May 2025 art. 163 (pp. 97-98, sha256 560d16410d3e41dc0bfb00bfe2a40ef65f2cd900234aeaee92018ed9fa21ead5)
requirements.remediation: Source the counting of the months, the part time and the taxation of each una tantum from its agreement, then resolve this limitation.
